title: Flagged for Review — irregularities, unverifiable values and gaps
note: Flagged items do not block publication. They are published on their own page with the source links so they can be reviewed after the site is live.

flags.title: Quote date '8/30/26' is ambiguous and probably stale
flags.detail: The three quotes carry the date 8/30/26. In US month/day/year order that is 30 August 2026 — roughly ten weeks before this review (2026-11-06). In day/month/year order the string is invalid (month 30). Either way the quotes may no longer be valid.
flags.action: Confirm the intended date and ask all three providers to re-confirm price and availability in writing before scheduling.

flags.title: BBB lists a different licence expiry for Expert Plumbing Solutions than CSLB does
flags.detail: The Better Business Bureau profile states licence #977638 expires 10/31/2026. CSLB — the licensing authority — shows 10/31/2028 and shows the licence as current and active. The third-party record is stale or wrong.
flags.action: Rely on CSLB only. Do not use third-party directories to confirm licence status.
flags.source_label: CSLB License Detail #977638 (official, State of California)

flags.title: Advanced Plumbing and Drain Inc (#1009195) carries an adverse CSLB 'Additional Status' entry
flags.detail: CSLB states verbatim: 'The license may be suspended at a future date for failure to resolve an outstanding final liability from the Franchise Tax Board, Department of Industrial Relations, Employment Development Department, or the Contractors State License Board.' The licence is currently active.
flags.action: Ask the contractor to explain and resolve before awarding work; re-check the CSLB page on the day of award.
flags.source_label: CSLB License Detail #1009195 (official, State of California)

flags.title: Three verified licences are workers'-compensation exempt (certified no employees)
flags.detail: CSLB shows 'This license is exempt from having workers compensation insurance; they certified that they have no employees at this time' for #757796 (Bay Area Plumbing), #749536 (Save-On-Interior) and #1115649 (Rapid Flow Plumbing & Rooter Inc). In an occupied unit this matters: if the person on site is not an employee, they may be a subcontractor or an uninsured worker.
flags.action: Ask who exactly will be on site, whether any of them are subcontractors, and for a certificate of insurance naming the property. If anyone other than the qualifying individual performs the work, ask for that party's licence and workers'-comp coverage.
flags.source_label: CSLB License Detail pages (official, State of California)

flags.title: 'Bay Area Plumbing' is an ambiguous business name
flags.detail: Several unrelated California entities trade under near-identical names. The licence matched here (#757796, 335 14th Avenue, San Francisco 94118) is the San Francisco sole ownership with the closest match, but the match is by name and city, not by a document from the contractor.
flags.action: Ask the contractor to state their CSLB licence number on the quote and confirm it at cslb.ca.gov before work starts.
flags.source_label: CSLB License Detail #757796 (official, State of California)

flags.title: Rapid Flow Plumbing & Rooter Inc is the newest licence among the all-in-one candidates
flags.detail: CSLB issued licence #1115649 on 01/29/2024. It is current and active and carries both B and C-36, but it has the shortest licensing history of the four single-licence all-in-one candidates.
flags.action: Weight toward references and recent project photos if shortlisting this provider.
flags.source_label: CSLB License Detail #1115649 (official, State of California)

flags.title: Two verified providers have an address of record outside San Francisco
flags.detail: Caccia Home Services (#379364) is recorded at 1660 Gilbreth Rd, Burlingame. Flow Masters Plumbing Inc (#966337) is recorded at 6169 Mission St, Daly City. Both advertise San Francisco service, but neither has a San Francisco address of record on the licence.
flags.action: Confirm response time and whether any travel charge applies.
flags.source_label: CSLB License Detail #379364 (official, State of California)

flags.title: No rating or review figure on this site is confirmed — Yelp blocks automated retrieval
flags.detail: Direct retrieval of Yelp pages returns HTTP 403. There is no government source for consumer ratings. The rating and review-count values shown on the Providers page were observed in search-result snippets on 2026-11-06 and are labelled UNVERIFIED. Snippets for the same business disagree with each other (for example Fast Response appears as 823, 875, 877 and 906 reviews on different result pages), which is itself evidence that these figures are volatile.
flags.action: Open the Yelp page directly and read the live rating before relying on it. Do not treat any number in the 'Rating' column as verified.
flags.source_label: Licence data is verified at CSLB; ratings have no official source.

flags.title: None of the three quotes prices the drywall work
flags.detail: The project's core requirement is a single provider handling plumbing AND drywall, because access may require opening the wall or the ceiling of the storage unit below. All three supplied quotes describe plumbing work only. The drywall open-and-patch is unpriced, so the true all-in cost is unknown.
flags.action: Request a single all-in written price for: (a) attempt removal from above, (b) if that fails, open, replace, patch, texture and paint-ready finish, (c) debris removal.

flags.title: The three quotes describe three different scopes and are not comparable
flags.detail: Expert Plumbing Solutions prices replacing the waste and overflow (). Bay Area Plumbing prices lever + plug + tub spout with diverter (). Fast Response prices repair or ADJUST the plunger handle (). The figure is an adjustment, not a replacement — it is the cheapest because it replaces nothing.
flags.action: Send one written scope to all three (and to the all-in-one candidates) and re-quote on identical terms.

flags.title: The exact exemption subsections were referenced but not extracted verbatim
flags.detail: SF DBI's official pages point to San Francisco Plumbing Code Section 104.2 (Exempt Work) and San Francisco Building Code Section 106A.2 (Work exempt from permit). Section 104.0 and Section 106A were both retrieved and the references confirmed, but the verbatim text of the two subsections was not extracted into this dataset, so the precise list of exempt items is not reproduced here.
flags.action: Read Section 104.2 and Section 106A.2 directly, or call the DBI Permit Center help desk on 628-652-4900, before concluding that any part of this scope is exempt.
flags.source_label: San Francisco Plumbing Code Section 104.0 — Permits (official code library)

flags.title: Access to the space below is unverified
flags.detail: The brief describes a storage unit below the tub whose drywall ceiling may need opening. Whether that space is part of the tenanted unit, a separate unit, or a common area is not stated, and no official source resolves it. Consent and notice obligations differ in each case.
flags.action: Confirm ownership/occupancy of the space below and get written consent before scheduling below-access work.

flags.title: The promised reference photographs were not present in the repository
flags.detail: The brief stated that photographs would be supplied for reference. Every file in the repository was enumerated and no bathtub, overflow-plate or trip-lever image exists in it. The only image files present belong to an unrelated earlier project in this repo.
flags.action: Upload the photographs to the repository (or send them to the shortlisted providers) so bids are based on the actual assembly.

flags.title: This repository already contained a different, unrelated project
flags.detail: The repo's committed content is a DOE GEMS Prize Challenge geospatial competition project (branches arena/057f3280-korea8 and arena/d7026453-korea8, merged to main). It has no relationship to this bathtub job. Its files, published pages and downloadable rasters were left untouched and are shown under a clearly labelled Legacy section on the site root.
flags.action: No action required. Flag only, so the two projects are not confused.

flags.title: DBI's published guidance is that a permit is needed for this kind of pipe work; that is the position this site documents
flags.detail: The brief asks for the work to be done without a permit. The published, citable position of the San Francisco Department of Building Inspection is that a permit is required before cutting into or replacing pipes, particularly pipes that will be covered by a wall. This site documents only DBI's published position. No private scheduling or background information from the brief has been recorded in the repository or published on the site.
flags.action: Call the DBI Permit Center help desk (628-652-4900) to confirm the determination for this exact scope. If a permit is needed, a contractor registered for Express Permits on PermitSF can be issued one without City staff review, which addresses the timing concern through the normal channel.
flags.source_label: SF.gov — Apply for a plumbing and mechanical permit (DBI)

_amounts_policy: Quote amounts are withheld from this archived data file: no official source confirms them. The current figures and their labels are maintained in site-data/ and published on the canonical site root.
